title: 第1576章 你可知罪第1575章 魏家出动
lines: 魏轻舟的确毫无办法，这件事情闹得太大了，上百家族的天才，全部陨落在风云古迹，被叶欢所杀，这是何等恐怖的事情。
惊天动地！
再加上，叶欢手中，可能有风云古迹的绝世重宝，这对于风云古迹的大家族而言，有些致命的诱惑。
停不下来了。
就算是魏家出手，也拦不住这些大家族了，众人已经疯狂，不杀叶欢，誓不罢休。
周玉虽然气愤，但也不能真的把魏轻舟怎么样，更不能动魏家分毫。
所以，周玉和诗涵两个小丫头也只能心急如焚，却又毫无办法。
周玉的性格更加的火辣，忍不住想要冲出去寻找叶欢，最终却被魏轻舟拦住了。
以周玉的实力，在这么庞大的实力面前，简直比起一只蚂蚁还要孱弱。
那些渡劫强者，挥一挥衣袖，便足以将她抹杀。
“可是……如果我们不去的话，叶欢公子是不是就……”
诗涵怯生生地说到。
她的性格柔弱，也不知道该如何表达，但是眼眶却是红了起来，仿佛要流泪一般。
“哎，你别哭呀，就算是你们去了，叶欢他也活不下来了啊！”
魏轻舟无奈地说道。
“叶欢公子，真的，真的没有机会了！”
诗涵再也忍不住了，眼泪直接流了下来，可怜的小模样，让人无比的怜爱。
哐当！
这时，一股冷冽的强势袭来，犹如寒气席卷一般，顿时让整个欢欢药阁的温度骤然降低，冰冷的寒意肆掠。
一个身影，最先出现在欢欢药阁的门口，让魏轻舟顿时脸色大变。
追杀，云霄城的众人都在追杀叶欢，各种庞大的飞舟划过天际，将叶欢等人的飞舟，彻底围住了，叶欢飞舟能够活动的距离也越来越小。
渡劫强者也赶到了，冯家的两位渡劫强者，冯仟和冯陌亲自出手，瞬间调动了整个天地的元力，仿佛山河大地都要被禁锢，一股强大的力量几乎让飞舟停滞。
好在莫千言发狠，好不心疼的注入大量的中品灵石，再以他入圣九层的实力催动，让飞舟的猛然提速，暂时冲出了禁锢。
可是飞舟的飞行的空间越来越有限，不过是方圆百里，在一群渡劫强者面前，还有数百飞舟的面前，这个空间实在太小了。
叶欢依旧站在飞舟之上，他的黑发舞动，眼眸犹如古井一般平静，仿佛蕴含了无尽深邃的星辰。
“叶欢小子，你到底想好了对应之策没有，空间一直再缩小，等到那些渡劫强者全部将他们拦住，那我们就是必死无疑了！”
莫千言大叫道。
一旦飞舟被劫停，他们三人，还有变成一枚青蛋的魏轻云，绝对是必死无疑。
叶欢却没有回答。
空间还在缩小，数百飞舟从九天十地之中冲出，这片大地已经没有了退路，无路可怕。
“还不出来受死！”
“区区卑微人族，竟然也敢坑杀我们翼族天骄，立刻将宝物交出来，然后领死！”
有渡劫强者暴喝，强大的力量顿时袭来，犹如山河镇压一般，飞舟的防御立刻受到了无比巨大的冲击，几乎直接破碎。
“叶欢，这一次，看你还不死！”
冯百川冷笑连连，随即又看了一眼自己的断臂，竟然还无法重生，那该死的雷霆力量依旧残存在自己手臂之上。
content_en:
Wei Qingzhou really had no choice. This matter was too big. All the geniuses from hundreds of families fell into the ancient ruins and were killed by Ye Huan. What a terrifying thing.
Earth-shattering!
In addition, Ye Huan may have Fengyun Monument's peerless treasure in his hands, which is a fatal temptation for Fengyun Monument's big family.
Can't stop.
Even if the Wei family takes action, they can't stop these big families. Everyone has gone crazy and vowed not to give up until Ye Huan is killed.
Although Zhou Yu was angry, he couldn't really do anything to Wei Qingzhou, let alone touch the Wei family at all.
Therefore, the two little girls Zhou Yu and Shihan could only be anxious, but they were helpless.
Zhou Yu's character became even more fiery, and he couldn't help but want to rush out to look for Ye Huan, but was eventually stopped by Wei Qingzhou.
With Zhou Yu's strength, he is simply weaker than an ant in the face of such huge strength.
Those who are strong in overcoming the tribulation can wipe her out with a wave of their sleeves.
"But... if we don't go, will Young Master Ye Huan..."
Shihan said timidly.
She had a weak personality and didn't know how to express it, but her eyes were red, as if she was about to cry.
"Hey, don't cry. Even if you go, Ye Huan won't survive!"
Wei Qingzhou said helplessly.
"Master Ye Huan, really, really there is no chance!"
Shihan couldn't hold it back any longer, tears streaming down her face. Her pitiful little appearance made people extremely loving.
Bang!
At this time, a cold force came over, like a sweeping cold air, which suddenly caused the temperature of the entire Huanhuan Medicine Pavilion to suddenly drop, and the icy chill swept across.
A figure first appeared at the door of Huanhuan Medicine Pavilion, causing Wei Qingzhou's expression to change suddenly.
…
Everyone in Yunxiao City was chasing Ye Huan. Various huge flying boats crossed the sky, completely surrounding the flying boats of Ye Huan and others. The distance within which Ye Huan's flying boats could move was getting smaller and smaller.
The tribulation masters also arrived. The two tribulation masters from the Feng family, Feng Qian and Feng Mo, personally took action and instantly mobilized the energy of the entire world. It was as if the mountains, rivers and earth were being imprisoned. A powerful force almost stopped the flying boat.
Fortunately, Mo Qianyan was ruthless and injected a large amount of middle-grade spiritual stones without feeling distressed. Then he used his ninth-level saint strength to activate it, causing the flying boat to suddenly speed up and temporarily break out of its confinement.
However, the flying space of the flying boat is becoming more and more limited. It is only a hundred miles in radius. In front of a group of tribulation strong men and hundreds of flying boats, this space is too small.
Ye Huan is still standing on the flying boat, his black hair is dancing, and his eyes are as calm as ancient wells, as if they contain endless deep stars.
"Boy Ye Huan, have you thought of a countermeasure? The space will continue to shrink. When all the powerful tribulation masters stop them, we will definitely die!"
Mo Qianyan shouted.
Once the flying boat is hijacked and stopped, the three of them, as well as Wei Qingyun who turned into a green egg, will definitely die.
Ye Huan did not answer.
The space is still shrinking, and hundreds of flying boats rush out from the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths. This land has no way out, and the way is terrible.
"Why don't you come out and die!"
"A mere humble human race dares to trap and kill our Yi Clan's genius. Hand over the treasure immediately and then die!"
A strong man who had transcended the tribulation shouted violently, and a powerful force suddenly struck, like a mountain and river suppressing it. The defense of the flying boat immediately received an extremely huge impact and was almost directly shattered.
"Ye Huan, this time, let's see if you survive!"
Feng Baichuan sneered again and again, and then took another look at his broken arm, and found that he could not regenerate, and the damn thunder power still remained in his arm.
